To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the observed variability of GRB parameters with the time scale from months to years is consistent with the hypothesis that GRBs are produced by the same process as solar hard X-ray and hard gamma-ray flares and that terrestrial gamma-ray flashes are a scaled-down version of GRBs.

the observed long-term variation of average observational characteristics of gamma-ray bursts and the correlation properties between different GRB parameters with time are similar to that observed for solar hard X-ray and soft gamma-ray flares and for terrestrial gamma-ray flashes.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the origin of GRBs.
the following questions: What are gamma-ray bursts? Where do gamma-ray bursts originate? How do gamma-ray bursts occur? What is the mechanism of gamma-ray bursts?

the following: the origin of gamma ray bursts; their possible association with solar flares; the possible role of electrical discharge in space; the possible role played by the heliosphere in the origin of gamma-ray bursts; and a new model of gamma ray bursts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
GRBs are produced by the interaction between the interstellar and interplanetary magnetic fields.
a heliospheric origin of gamma-ray bursts, at least for a fraction of the observed bursts, cannot be excluded.
the heliospheric origin of GRBs cannot be ruled out.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the GRBs observed by BATSE are not a uniform phenomenon, but rather are a collection of different phenomena.
GRBs may be a manifestation of the same physical processes as solar and terrestrial gamma-ray bursts.
a significant fraction of GRBs are generated by electrical discharges within the heliospheric plasma environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the heliospheric origin of gamma-ray bursts is not ruled out by the data.
GRBs are not necessarily of cosmological origin.
GRBs may be produced in the outer helio-sphere, at least partly.
